symptom: `rename constant M.C_Root to C_Base` printed "Renamed constant" with no reference count, and mx check then reported CE1613 "The selected constant 'M.C_Root' no longer exists" at every activity using it (create variable, log message, end event). A cross-module `move constant` the same. `rename enumeration` renamed a value that was the whole expression but not one inside a longer one (`$S = M.Status.Open and …` → CE0117). Found while fixing ako/mxcli#1443, which had hidden it (ako/mxcli#1671)
cause: The reference sweep's two primitives (RenameReferences → replaceQNInValueCounted, and UpdateQualifiedNameInAllUnits → replaceQualifiedNameRef, used by cross-module MOVE) rewrite a stored string only when it EQUALS the old qualified name or STARTS WITH it plus '.'. An expression always writes a constant as `@Module.Name`, so not even a constant that is the whole expression matched; an enumeration value matched only as the whole expression
insight: Expressions live under ordinary keys (InitialValue, Expression, ReturnValue, XpathConstraint, a split's Caption), so a key list would be a maintenance trap; instead apply a token-aware rewrite to every string the whole-string match leaves alone, which is safe because the tokens are unambiguous: `@` + qualified name + non-name byte is only ever a constant, and `QN.Member` not preceded by a name byte, '.', '/', '$' or '@' is only a member access (the '/' guard keeps association path steps out). Skip single-quoted literals with '' escapes, or a log message that quotes the name gets rewritten. Leave the module-prefix pair ("Old." → "New.") alone — module rename is its own open problem. Use `mxcli bson dump --format ndsl | grep` to find which keys hold a name; it is faster than writing a BSON walker (no pymongo in the devcontainer). Neither MDL nor this fix can author `@M.C` inside an XPath — the grammar parses `@` as a one-word step — so cover the XPath form with the rewriter's unit tests. Revert each primitive separately: the cross-module move assertion fails only with replaceQualifiedNameRef reverted. Separate defect kept out: `move enumeration` returns before the cross-module sweep runs at all
